_comment: Overrides the /stops/ body only. One entry is missing 'id', the other is missing 'name' -- the old code direct-indexed names[s['id']] = s['name'] and would KeyError on either (IMPORTANT 3). The fixed stop_names() must skip both and return an empty/partial dict instead of crashing; fetch_trips then falls back to the raw destination_stop id as the display text.
